*Work in progress.*

This paper studies how parents adjust their investments in response to children's endowments. Using the UK Millennium Cohort Study, it follows families from early childhood through adolescence and leverages variation in children's inherited educational-attainment polygenic scores, conditional on their parents' scores, to examine whether parental responses reinforce or compensate for differences between children.
